name: github.com/openshift-online/rh-trex-ai/components/api-server
reason: The framework replaced glog and its Logger interface with log/slog (openshift-online/rh-trex-ai#70, feat(logger)!: replace glog and the Logger interface with log/slog). HyperShell needs it to export API server logs over OpenTelemetry with trace and span IDs (specs/platform/api-server-observability.spec.md API-OBS-09): the framework now passes the request context with every record and keeps a program's own slog default. The pin also carries the earlier #67 (fix(db): run DAO sessions on the request transaction) and #68 that the previous pin 014cfa0 was taken for. The framework publishes no tag for this module path, so a pseudo-version is required. The commit merged to main as fc88cf6 and is under the 14 day minimum age until 2026-11-04; remove this age note then if no newer pin replaced it.
compensatingVerification: The dependency is commit-pinned; API server formatting, vet, golangci-lint, unit tests (including pkg/logging, which runs the framework's HTTP logging middleware at debug level and checks no header or body is logged), and integration tests run against that exact commit.
